Integrations/Data

NocoDB

Free & open source Airtable alternative. NocoDB turns any database into a smart spreadsheet with REST APIs.

27 actionsAPI key

Connect NocoDB

What your bot can do in NocoDB

Looks up

  • Get Application InfoGet comprehensive NocoDB application information including authentication settings, version, limits, and deployment configuration.
  • Get Table SchemaRetrieve complete schema information for a specific table.
  • Get User InfoGet authenticated user information including email, name, roles, and profile details.
  • List IntegrationsRetrieve all available integrations in NocoDB.
  • List NotificationsRetrieve paginated notification records for the authenticated user.
  • List Workspace BasesList all bases in a NocoDB workspace.
  • Convert URL to Database ConfigConvert JDBC URL or database connection URL to connection configuration object.
  • Get Aggregated Meta InfoGet aggregated meta information such as tableCount, dbViewCount, viewCount and other statistics about the NocoDB instance.
  • Get Application Health StatusGet the NocoDB application health status.
  • Get Cloud FeaturesGet NocoDB Cloud features.
Show 7 more
  • Get Command Palette SuggestionsGet dynamic command palette suggestions based on scope.
  • Get Integration InfoRetrieve metadata for a specific NocoDB integration by type and subtype.
  • Get Plugin StatusCheck if a NocoDB plugin is active or not.
  • Get Product FeedGet NocoDB product feed from social media sources including GitHub, YouTube, Twitter, and Cloud.
  • Get Sort MetadataRetrieve sort configuration by ID from NocoDB.
  • List Public Shared View Grouped DataRetrieve grouped data from a publicly shared NocoDB view.
  • Poll NotificationsPoll for notifications using long-polling mechanism.

Takes action

  • Sign Out UserSign out the authenticated user and clear their refresh token from the database and cookie.
  • Update User ProfileUpdate authenticated user's profile information including display name, first name, and last name.
  • Delete NotificationDelete a notification for the authenticated user.
  • Delete Table View RowDelete a specific row from a table view in NocoDB.
  • Delete ViewDelete a view from a NocoDB table.
  • Forgot PasswordInitiate password reset process by sending a reset email to the user.
  • Report ErrorReport errors to NocoDB's error tracking system.
  • Store Integration ConfigurationStore configuration for a NocoDB integration.
  • Update View ColumnUpdate a column configuration in a view.
  • Upload Attachments by URLUpload attachments from remote URLs to NocoDB storage.
